gloss: in the midst of, in the thick of

definitions.gloss: in the midst of, in the thick of, in the vortex of
definitions.explanation: Being at the center of a turbulent situation, controversy, or crisis. Literally means 'inside a whirlpool' and is used figuratively for being caught up in the middle of chaotic or problematic events.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{渦中|かちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: To be in the thick of an incident.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧スキャンダル⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{渦中|かちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人物|じんぶつ}→人物：03356_jinbutsu⟧だ。
examples.english: He is the person at the center of the scandal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧⟦{改革|かいかく}→改革：04815_kaikaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{渦中|かちゅう}にあって、⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{冷静|れいせい}→冷静：03781_reisei⟧さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}った→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧。
examples.english: In the midst of political reform, she maintained her composure.

notes:
USAGE:
Literally "inside a whirlpool" (⟦{渦|うず}→渦：01859_uzu⟧ = whirlpool, ⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ = inside). Used exclusively in a figurative sense to describe being at the center of a controversy, crisis, or turbulent situation. It does not refer to a literal whirlpool.

Almost always appears in the patterns {渦中|かちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧, {渦中|かちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧, or {渦中|かちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun. Commonly seen in news reporting and formal writing.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {渦中|かちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: to be in the midst of
- {渦中|かちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to be in the midst of (more formal)
- {渦中|かちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人物|じんぶつ}→人物：03356_jinbutsu⟧: the person at the center (of a controversy)
- {渦中|かちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{巻|ま}き{込|こ}まれる→巻き込む：05753_makikomu⟧: to be drawn into the middle of
